_comment: Proposed conventions of each CAD profile (the second half of the table that would become pcbthermal/data/cad_profiles.json). Every field is a default that the import window shows and the user can change. 'seen' = measured in the sample sets (README 3.4, 4, 5, 6); 'M' = from memory, not seen. A field the study could not measure is left out rather than guessed.

generic.layer_function: X2 FileFunction, then Excellon header, then the file name rules of pcbthermal.gerber.functions

drill.dialect: Excellon with FMAT,2 and comment header
drill.plated_from: x2 comment (31 of 32), merged file = MixedPlating (b-parasite, KiCad 7.0.1), PTH/NPTH in the name
drill.unit: inch or mm by plot option (20 / 12)

paste.to_c: only with the plot option 'include netlist attributes' (present in 47 of 187 files; absent in the sets of KiCad 5.1.5, 7.0.1, 7.0.6, 7.0.9 and 9.0.0, present in 5.1.6, 5.1.7, 5.1.8, 8.0.4, 8.99 and 9.0.1: the plot option, not the version, decides)

placement.bottom_x: per file: as is (cmm2) or negated (isastm) in the same 5.1.x; detect, never preset

kicad.odb: ODB_SOURCE=KiCad EDA, SAVE_APP=KiCad EDA 9.0.3 in misc/info (seen)

altium.units: IN or MM by the project
altium.layer_order: G04 Layer_Physical_Order=n gives the stack position (32 files of the sets carry it: the copper layers of the newer versions)

outline.source: .GKO (keep-out) and/or .GM1 (mechanical 1); both may hold stubs and dimension marks
outline.closed_contour: failed at 0.01 mm in 5 of the Altium/CircuitMaker outline files; pruning dangling segments gave a closed contour of the board's size in 3 (linkcard GM1, simplefoc GM1, hydro GKO), a wrong tiny box in 1 (hydro GM1, a mechanical layer with other drawings) and nothing in 1 (LimeSDR GM1) (README 5.1)

drill.dialect: Excellon, header ;FILE_FORMAT=a:b, ;TYPE=PLATED|NON_PLATED, ;Layer_Color=, T1F00S00C..., INCH,LZ or METRIC,LZ|TZ

placement.M: Pick Place file with Mid X / Mid Y and unit suffixes (not seen in the sets)

eagle.x2: file_function from 9.0 (28 of 60 files; the 'RS-274X export' files of older versions and of Fusion Electronics have none)

drill.dialect: Excellon .xln with ;GenerationSoftware,Autodesk,EAGLE comments, FMAT,2, ICI,OFF, METRIC,TZ or INCH,TZ

eagle.gbrjob: Fusion Electronics names itself in gerber_job.gbrjob (Application: Fusion Electronics) while the Gerber files carry the EAGLE banner

allegro.layer_told_by: G04 Film Name: <name> in the identification record (the film names are the user's: TOP, GND2, lyr3, l1_primary)

outline.source: no outline file in the 6 sets (the outline is drawn on the film layers or is the .rou file); the program has no outline then

drill.dialect: Excellon, ;LEADER/;HEADER/;CODE comments, per-tool comments with Holesize and Quantity (declared counts 287 and 1991 = holes read), METRIC or INCH; a file can omit M48 and the T codes (BeagleBone AI: coordinates only)

gerber.mirror: assembly films carry %MIA1B0*% (image mirror): refused by the program; they are not needed

xpedition.units: IN (the output definition of the samples)
layer_rules: other (a drawing of the holes, not a drill file)

outline.source: BoardOutlline.gdo (sic, two l) or BoardOutline.gdo in 4 of 8 sets; 4 sets have none

drill.dialect: Excellon .ncd: ; Version : LOCAL, ; Format : 3.3 / Absolute / MM / Leading (the word names the SUPPRESSED zeros), METRIC,TZ or INCH,LZ, FMAT,2, ICI,OFF, M71, G90 and a G93X0Y0 line in all 17 files
drill.adjust: G93X0Y0 is a zero origin shift: ignore it (the program refuses the whole file: 17 of 17); a punch file (ThruHolePunchPlated.ncd) has tools without a diameter and stays refused

paste.present: yes (SolderPasteTop/Bottom; the top only on some boards)

xpedition.support: .gpf plot setup says 'Xpedition Layout Gerber Output'; the PADS Pro / Xpedition Enterprise newer outputs were not seen

drill.dialect: Excellon with a leading % line before T codes (Drill.drl)

pads.M: the SM/SS meaning of the names is from the layout of the files, no PADS document opened

outline.closed_contour: failed at 0.01 mm in 2 of 5 sets (datenzwerg, simplefoc); pruning closed one (simplefoc), the other is an open contour

drill.dialect: plain Excellon, no comments, INCH or METRIC,000.00
drill.plated_from: none (PTH and NPTH are not told apart in the 5 files)

proteus.support: CADCAM READ-ME.TXT names the program; drill files are written as Gerber X2 (.GBR, Plated)

drill.dialect: Excellon FMAT,1 (G81 drill commands), no plating information

placement.columns: Ref,Part Name,Side,X,Y,Rotation with four preamble lines (title, date, Units,mm, blank); the program's parser refuses the file (README 6); Part Name is not a KiCad footprint name, so the envelope rule finds 8 of 86 parts

drill.dialect: Excellon FMAT,2 METRIC,TZ; DRILLS-PTH / DRILLS-NPTH in the name

outline.closed_contour: failed at 0.01 mm, closes at 0.1 mm (the ends are 0.01 to 0.1 mm apart)

pcbrnd.adjust: a project name such as 'power-art' made the program's name rules read assembly and fab files as copper (the word 'power')

drill.dialect: plain Excellon with a leading % line before M48 (the program's header detector needs M48 first)

gerber.macro_names: names with a hyphen (AMRect-W1650000-H1650000-RO1.500); not allowed by the specification; the program refuses 5 files, renaming the macros reads all with the area within 0.24 % of gerbonara

drill.dialect: M71,TZ header (the program refuses: no unit; METRIC,TZ reads 63 holes)

outline.closed_contour: failed at 0.01 mm; pruning one stub closes it

placement.M: .PosiTop / .PosiBot are Gerber placement-print layers (silkscreen), not coordinate lists

gerber.quirks: no comments, G54D<n> before every aperture selection, D02 then G55D03 for flashes, M00 end of file, one long line (README 3.5); all from the gerbonara emulation script, not from a real CR-8000 file

drill.dialect: .fdr: INCH,LZ ICI,OFF VER,1 FMAT,2 DETECT,ON ATC,ON; .fdl drill list ('***** DRILL LIST *****')

zuken.status: emulation only: no real Zuken CR-8000, CR-5000 or CADSTAR file was obtained

cam350.note: a CAM tool: the original program is not known; apertures can be used before they are defined (the .apr wheel is separate), the program refuses 3 of 11 files

ucamx.note: a CAM tool; X2 complete (FileFunction, TO, TA)
